review.posthog_relevance: Adds backend and frontend support for bulk updating the 'verified' status of Event Definitions, including request serialization, permission registration, transaction safety, and UI actions.
review.reason: The observed hunks demonstrate a substantive, bounded implementation of a bulk update capability. P1.F1.H2 and P1.F6.H7/H8 show the addition of backend and frontend action handling for bulk verification. P1.F7.H5 and P1.F7.H6 establish the necessary permission and transaction safety mechanisms. P1.F2.H2 and P1.F7.H7 show the removal of the old UI and addition of the new serializer.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the backend API endpoint, the database migration, or the complete frontend modal and form components. While the supporting infrastructure and request handling are present, the full execution and database changes are not visible, preventing a definitive assessment of tier 3 (systemic risk reduction or broader capability).
